tidbit: Did you know… one story this hour was carried by two different outlets in the last few hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Meta removed a provision that raised concerns about scraping and training business site content, clarifying the policy only applied to ads. Reported by TechCrunch: Confirmed.
Anthropic released a draft bill proposing shutdowns for artificial intelligence models posing major risks. Reported by Crypto Briefing.
China is restricting 40 tech exports, including artificial intelligence and chips, citing national security concerns. Reported by 毎日新聞.
Claude solved a 25-year NSA cryptographic mystery in 30 minutes, identifying seed origins in 1997 and 1998 timestamps. Reported by Cointribune.
Taiwan is moving to strengthen export controls on Chinese artificial intelligence chips, aligning with US efforts. Reported by 지디넷코리아.
